question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE (deceased IS NULL OR deceased.boolean = FALSE)
    AND name IS NOT NULL 
    AND ARRAY_LENGTH(name) > 0
    AND name[OFFSET(0)].family LIKE 'A%'
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM living_patients p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT pwc.id as patient_id,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM patients_with_one_condition pwc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = pwc.id
),
patient_active_meds AS (
  SELECT pc.patient_id,
         pc.condition_code,
         pc.condition_display,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_active_meds
  FROM patient_conditions pc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr 
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pc.patient_id
    AND mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY pc.patient_id, pc.condition_code, pc.condition_display
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT condition_display, 
         condition_code,
         MAX(num_active_meds) as max_active_meds
  FROM patient_active_meds
  GROUP BY condition_display, condition_code
)
SELECT condition_display, condition_code, max_active_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_active_meds DESC, condition_display ASC
LIMIT 8
